decision: ENV-U10 (user, 2026-09-30): themed CC0 ground between the map frame and the tray edge - Marmoreal: marble paving by the palace + dark earth with petals; Sarpedon: forest floor, sand, ship deck planks under the ship, pebbles at the river mouth. ENV-U5: only the downloaded CC0 sets (no new downloads).

tools.import: tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_env_ground.py (--prep: CC0 -> 2K BC/N/ORMH staging PNGs; UE: textures, M_EnvGround, MI_EnvGround_<Map>)

tray.source: P2 shared tray of both maps (track TRAY default; C:/tmp/envmaps-research/p2/tray-extents.json). ground_splat.py warns when that file or a layout tray disagrees.

splat.note: RGBA8, linear. R/G/B = coverage of layers L1/L2/L3 stacked over the base L0 (L3 on top), A = accent density (Marmoreal petals, Sarpedon wetness). The texture covers splatRect = tray rect (union of this tray and the layout tray) + marginUU, rounded outward; row 0 = the far side (-Y), column 0 = -X.

material.note: heightBlend per layer L1..L3 (0..1) scales how much the layer's height shapes its border; accent.carpet = the pink carpet strength under dense petals (petals mode only)

Tiles143.note: square travertine tiles (beige) - desaturated to pale marble paving

Planks023A.note: deck planks; rotated 90 deg in the staging (image + DirectX normal XY) so the planks run along board +Y, parallel to the hull line

layers.role: dark earth (base; the cherry beds under a carpet of petals)
moss under the cherries, round the cypresses, along the tray rim and the paving edge
grass tufts in the outer W / E beds
marble paving: palace terrace N, walkway round the frame, lamp / plinth pads
sand: beach N-centre, river banks, fire clearings
pebbles: both river channels (mouth N, waterfall exit S), fort rubble
ship deck planks: E band under the hull and cannons, quay N-E and S-E

river.source: measured on the map illustration (scraped-data/images/maps/sarpedon.webp, out of git): water runs x at the map edges, board uu
